description: Estimate exact cost and output dimensions for Topaz, Crystal, or Runway Magnific image upscale.

height.description: Known source image height in pixels (must be paired with width).
height.title: Height

image_url.description: Owned image key or URL from POST /api/v1/uploads or your own generation.
image_url.title: Image Url

model.description: Image upscale model: topaz-image-upscale (alias topaz), crystal-upscale (crystal), or runway-image-upscale (runway/magnific).
model.title: Model

scale_factor.description: Upscale multiplier: Topaz 2/3/4, Crystal 2/3/4/6, Runway Magnific 2/4/8/16.
scale_factor.title: Scale Factor

source_generation_id.description: ID of your completed image generation to upscale.
source_generation_id.title: Source Generation Id

topaz_model.description: Topaz model variant (default 'Standard V2'); used when model is topaz-image-upscale.
topaz_model.title: Topaz Model

width.description: Known source image width in pixels (must be paired with height).
width.title: Width

name: estimate_image_upscale
